title: Workshop Plan: Using Generative AI Responsibly in Teaching
aim: To help academic staff use generative AI tools in their teaching while protecting academic integrity.
introduction: Generative AI tools are now widely available to students and staff. This workshop introduces practical ways to use them in course design and assessment.
objectives: Explain what generative AI tools can and cannot do.
Design an assessment task that remains valid when students have access to AI tools.
Draft a course-level statement on acceptable AI use.

timetable.details: Group work in tables of five

assessment: Each group presents one redesigned assessment task.
Participants complete a short evaluation form.
